user.title: Connect to a Harmony NG Hub
user.description: Enter the address of a Hub running harmony-ng. The Hub is normally found automatically; use this when it is on another network.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Hub.
data_description.port: HTTP port of the Hub's API, 8089 unless changed.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: This Hub requires authentication. Create a Personal Access Token in the Hub's web UI under Users and paste it here.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The Hub refused the stored token. Enter a valid Personal Access Token.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure {name}
reconfigure.description: Change how Home Assistant reaches this Hub. The Hub must be the same unit.

data_description.token: Leave empty when the Hub does not require authentication.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Hub. Check the address and that the Hub is powered on.
error.not_harmony_ng: This is not a Hub running harmony-ng, or its firmware is too old to report an identity.
error.unsupported_firmware: The Hub's firmware is too old for this integration. Update harmony-ng on the Hub.
error.hub_mismatch: The Hub at this address is a different unit than the one configured.

abort.not_harmony_ng: The discovered device is not a Hub running a supported harmony-ng firmware.
abort.unsupported_firmware: The Hub's firmware is too old for this integration. Update harmony-ng on the Hub.

data_description.default_activity: Activity started by remote.turn_on when none is given.
data_description.delay_secs: Seconds between the commands of one remote.send_command call.

ir_send.name: Send device command
ir_send.description: Sends a command of a configured device on the chosen infrared outputs.

device_id.name: Hub
device_id.description: The Hub that controls the device.

device.name: Device
device.description: Name or id of the device in the Hub's inventory.

command.name: Command
command.description: Name of the command as the Hub knows it.

repeats.name: Repeats
repeats.description: How many times to send the command.

bt_key.name: Send Bluetooth key
bt_key.description: Sends a keyboard key to a Bluetooth host paired with the Hub.

device_id.name: Hub
device_id.description: The Hub paired with the host.

action.name: Action
action.description: Tap, press and hold, release, or release every key.

target.name: Host
target.description: Bluetooth address of the host; the connected host when empty.

activity_help.name: Help
activity_help.description: Re-sends the running activity's start commands and returns the devices whose power is a toggle, so you can answer whether each is on.

activity_help_answer.name: Answer Help
activity_help_answer.description: Answers the Help question for one device: off sends its power toggle.

device.name: Device
device.description: Name or id of the device asked about.

on.name: Is on
on.description: Whether the device is on; off sends the power toggle.

activity_cancel.name: Cancel activity
activity_cancel.description: Clears a stuck activity change and returns the Hub to idle.

sync.name: Sync remotes
sync.description: Pushes the Hub's configuration to the paired remotes.

hub_busy.message: The Hub is busy with another activity change.

auth_failed.message: The Hub refused the stored token.

device_not_found.message: No device named {device} in the Hub's inventory.

no_activity.message: No activity given and no previous activity to start.

device_required.message: A device is required to send a command.

target_not_found.message: Device {device_id} does not belong to a Harmony NG Hub.

firmware_too_old.message: The Hub's firmware is too old: {error}

hub_mismatch.message: The Hub at this address is {found}, not {expected}.

firmware_too_old.title: {name} needs a firmware update
firmware_too_old.description: The Hub's harmony-ng firmware does not provide the API this integration needs ({error}). Update the firmware on the Hub, then reload the integration.

legacy_enabled.title: {name} has the Logitech protocol enabled
legacy_enabled.description: The Hub serves the stock Logitech protocol on port 8088, so the core Harmony integration can see the same Hub. Its entities would duplicate this integration's. Disable the setting on the Hub, or remove the core integration's entry for this Hub.
